projects.title: Residential Window Replacement — Bondi
projects.challenge: Old timber frames were drafty, difficult to operate, and impacting the home's thermal performance
projects.solution: Installed matching aluminium frames with double glazing across 8 windows
projects.result: Home is noticeably warmer, quieter, and more secure. Improved street appeal

projects.title: Commercial Shopfront Installation — Surry Hills
projects.shortDescription: Shopfront glass installation for new retail fit-out
projects.challenge: Retail space needed professional glazed shopfront to match design vision
projects.solution: Installed frameless glass panels with aluminium framing and swing entry door system
projects.result: Stunning modern storefront that increased visual appeal and customer foot traffic

projects.title: Frameless Shower Screen — Neutral Bay
projects.shortDescription: Bathroom renovation with frameless shower screen
projects.challenge: Outdated bathroom needed modern upgrade. Client wanted bright, open feel
projects.solution: Installed 10mm toughened frameless shower screen with brushed nickel fittings
projects.result: Bathroom transformed into spacious, luxurious retreat. Increased property appeal

projects.title: Emergency Glass Repair — Break-in Damage
projects.shortDescription: Same-day emergency glass replacement after break-in
projects.challenge: Home window smashed during break-in. Property needed to be secure overnight
projects.solution: Attended within 2 hours. Installed temporary board-up. Replaced glass same day
projects.result: Property secured immediately. New glass installed professionally within 24 hours

projects.title: Office Glass Partition — Sydney CBD

projects.challenge: Growing tech company needed flexible office spaces with professional aesthetics
projects.solution: Installed frameless glass partition walls with frosted panels for privacy
